headline: Red alert hits Visayas power grid anew
summary: The National Grid Corp. of the Philippines has placed the Visayas grid under red alert from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. due to power plant outages. Consumers may face interruptions.
why: Grid reliability affects industrial output and energy costs, which matters for manufacturers and utilities operating in the Philippines.

entities.name: National Grid Corp. of the Philippines
